BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 10.555, is amended to read:

10.555 [-CESAR CHAVEZ-][+ LATINO HERITAGE+] DAY.

[-(b) As a community organizer, Chavez improved the lives and working conditions of millions of Latinos nationwide. bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to state government; establishing Latino Heritage Day; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 10.555.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 10.555, is amended to read:

10.555 LATINO HERITAGE DAY.
March 31 shall be known as Latino Heritage Day to celebrate the growing Latino community in Minnesota. Latinos constitute a major demographic in the state. Dedicating March 31 each year as Latino Heritage Day provides the citizens of Minnesota the opportunity to learn about and appreciate the Latino community and the community's contributions to our state.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.
